subject.title: fix: keep yielded parent runs deferred until subagents settle

question: Should yielded cron handoff become a permanent public `deferred` status across persistence, Gateway protocol, plugin hooks/SDK, CLI, and UI, or remain an internal lifecycle state mapped to existing public contracts?
rationale: The branch deliberately expands compatibility-sensitive persisted and public unions; implementation correctness cannot determine the permanent product and API contract.

options.title: Keep deferral internal
options.body: Preserve existing public cron status contracts and represent yielded-parent waiting through internal lifecycle and task or session state.

options.title: Adopt public deferred status
options.body: Accept `deferred` only with explicit fresh-install, upgrade, SDK, protocol, CLI, UI, and external-client compatibility proof.

recommendation.title: Keep deferral internal
recommendation.body: Preserve existing public cron status contracts and represent yielded-parent waiting through internal lifecycle and task or session state.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest available recent history across the central Discord, subagent, and cron lifecycle surfaces affected by this decision.
